title: quercus tomentosa var. diversifolia
intro: Quercus tomentosa var. diversifolia, commonly known as the Korean oak, is a variety of deciduous tree native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus tomentosa var. diversifolia include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral activities, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been identified through various studies and analyses.
